notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: Speka i toktok wantaim bel bilong em yet — toktok direct long nefesh bilong em.

notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפש em i laip/breth bilong man, tasol Tok Pisin i no gat wanpela tok stret — bel i klostu.

notes.subject: seveisen bilong pes bilong mi
notes.rationale: ישועת פני: 'help/save bilong pes' — sampla i tanim 'em i save mi' (KJV 'health of my countenance'), narapela i tanim 'God em i seveisen bilong mi'.

notes.subject: refren
notes.rationale: Ves ya i wankain olsem Sal 42:5 na 42:11 — repetisen bilong refren, i lus long tanim tok.

notes.subject: ⟨em i⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i nidim kopula; Hibru i no gat tok bilong 'is' namel long seveisen na pes.

translation: Long wanem yu pundaun, bel bilong mi? Na long wanem yu krai stret long insait bilong mi? Holdim wait long Elohim, bilong wanem bai mi praisim ⟨em⟩ yet — ⟨em i⟩ seveisen bilong pes bilong mi, na Elohim bilong mi.
